examples.title: Basic inline confirmation
examples.description: Confirm a destructive action without leaving the current flow.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { InlineConfirm } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<InlineConfirm prompt="Remove this workspace?" confirmLabel="Remove workspace" open destructive />

examples.title: Two-press irreversible action
examples.description: Require an explicit second press without adding a competing Cancel action.
examples.code: <InlineConfirm presentation="two-press" confirmLabel="Refund $42.00" armedLabel="Press again to refund $42.00" armedHint="Reverts in 3 seconds. Escape cancels." requestKey="refund-42" />
